items.title: Rejecting closer EU ties would be dereliction of duty, PM to say
items.summary: Addressing the Commons, Burnham is expected to say that a new deal with the EU could help tackle illegal immigration and boost economic growth.

items.title: Man fatally attacked by tiger at UK wildlife park told animal to 'stop being naughty'
items.summary: The victim of the tiger attack at Yorkshire Wildlife Park told the animal to "stop being naughty" just before the incident, Sky News understands.

items.title: Healey faces £35bn Budget challenge to meet spending pledges, says think tank
items.summary: The Institute for Fiscal Studies says the government will need a "top-up" of billions of pounds if it wants to meet its spending plans.

items.title: 'Frankly shocking' breaches of road rules detected in AI technology trial
items.summary: Motorists have been caught driving with children on their lap and both hands on their phone rather than the wheel in a trial of AI-powered cameras.

items.title: PM believes Brexit vote was legitimate despite Russia claims, No 10 says
items.summary: It is "inconceivable" that Russia did not try to use the referendum to its advantage, No 10 said, but the PM believed it did not succeed in influencing the result.

items.title: Man denies racist murder of scientist as trial date set
items.summary: A man has denied the racially-aggravated murder of a scientist in Dundee.
